abstract: Malignant struma ovarii is a rare type of ovarian teratoma; only 16 cases with distant metastases have been reported previously. We report an extremely rare case of malignant struma ovarii metastatic to the cranial vault, which developed during pregnancy. A 28-year-old woman in the 26th week of pregnancy, who had undergone resection of an ovarian tumor 3 years previously, noticed a mass in her left frontal region that had enlarged gradually in 6 months. Magnetic resonance imaging revealed a massive extradural tumor growing through the cranium. Under fetal heart monitoring, the patient underwent total resection of the tumor, including the adjacent cranial bone and dura, and a healthy infant was delivered at full term. Pathological examination showed that the tumor was a follicular adenocarcinoma. Because there was no abnormality in the patient's thyroid gland, this tumor was considered to be a metastasis from the ovarian tumor, a malignant struma ovarii, resected 3 years previously. The management of brain tumor during pregnancy is also discussed.
abstract_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は稀な型の卵巣奇形腫であり、遠隔転移を伴った報告は従来16例に過ぎない。我々は妊娠中に発症し頭蓋骨に転移した悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の極めて稀な症例を報告する。28歳女性は妊娠26週時点で、3年前に卵巣腫瘍切除の既往があり、6か月かけて徐々に増大する左前頭部の腫瘤に気付いた。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では頭蓋を貫通して増殖する大きな硬膜外腫瘍が認められた。胎児心拍モニタリング下で、隣接する頭蓋骨と硬膜を含めた腫瘍の全摘出を行い、正期産で健常な児を娩出した。病理組織学的検査では濾胞状腺癌であった。甲状腺に異常がなかったことから、3年前に切除された悪性卵巣甲状腺腫からの転移と考えられた。妊娠中の脳腫瘍の管理についても考察する。
